w: Sector Los Angeles, Submerged Land Act (SLA)
d: Alcatel Submarine Networks Marine will conduct submarine telecommunications cable installation activities for Segment 6 of the ORCA Project from Hermosa Beach, California, to the offshore end of Segment 6 from August 24 through October 16, 2026. Operations will include route clearance, shore-end cable landing, cable burial, surface cable laying, and ROV operations along the cable route between 33.871435, -118.418618 and 37.387200, -128.266290. The C/S Ile de Sein will be engaged in these operations and will maintain a continuous listening watch on VHF-FM Channel 16. The vessel may be restricted in its ability to maneuver during certain phases of the work. For more information, contact the Master of C/S Ile de Sein at +47 23 67 48 00 or Luc Parkinson at +33 6 48 93 46 48.
